2026-10-06.riddle: Too much of everything, I overflow every reasonable limit without restraint.
2026-10-06.clue1: Beyond what is normal, needed, or proper.
2026-10-06.definition: More than what is necessary, usual, or reasonable; immoderate in amount or degree.
